Mr. Bharat R. Zaveri, the learned counsel for the respondent no.7 in Writ Petition No.6746 of 2024 tendered the list of dates and bgp Page | 2 931.6746.24-wp.docx events and made his submissions and relied on the judgment in "R. Pushpam & Anr. v. The State of Madras represented by the Secretary, Local Administration Department, Fort St George, Madras & Anr."

entities.text: R. Pushpam & Anr. v. The State of Madras
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Mr. Ashutosh A. Kumbhakoni, the learned senior counsel argued on behalf of the State and contended that the impugned amendment is a delegated piece of legislation and the Unified Development Control and Promotion Regulations, 2034 (UDCPR 2034) are legislative in nature and not executive.

entities.text: Unified Development Control and Promotion Regulations, 2034 (UDCPR 2034)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He has argued that it is solely at the option of the land owner whether to accept the TDR or to opt for the compensation against acquisition of his land.
In support of his arguments, the learned senior counsel has tendered the compilation of judgments which is taken on record.

He mainly relied on "Dental Council of India v. Biyani Shikshan Samiti & Anr." (2022) 6 SCC 65, "Pune Municipal Corporation & Anr. v. Promoters & Builders Association & Anr." (2004) 10 SCC 796,
"Janhit Manch v. State of Maharashtra" (2006) SCC Bom. 1145, "Amit Maru v. State of Maharashtra" (2014) 4 Bom CR 568 and the full Bench judgment of this Court in "Shree Vinayak Builders and Developers, Nagpur v. State of Maharashtra & Ors." 2022(4) Mh.L.J. 739.
